name: Live Attack Triage (DDoS Port 80 SYN Flood)
description: Demonstrates full multi-agent triage: calibrated ML classification, ATT&CK T1498 mapping, and Human-in-the-Loop gate.
query: High-volume ingress packet spike detected targeting web gateway on port 80. Excessive packet rates exceeding 100k packets/s observed.
key_talking_point: Show that LightGBM with Platt Scaling reduces calibration error to 0.0005, giving accurate probability rather than overconfident guesswork.

name: Benign Validation (Zero False Positive Check)
description: Demonstrates that the system does not raise false alarms on standard corporate traffic.
query: Standard outbound user HTTPS session to cloud services. Normal symmetric packet flow and standard duration.
key_talking_point: Zero False Positive Rate (FPR = 0.0000) on 6,000 held-out evaluation flows.

name: Historical Precedent Search
description: Demonstrates hybrid similarity search against historical incident repository.
query: Massive Mirai botnet volumetric DNS flood causing widespread DNS resolution disruption
key_talking_point: Highlight shared characteristics vs key operational differences extracted automatically.

name: Genuine Failure & Insufficient Evidence Handling
description: Demonstrates proper abstention when query is out-of-domain or ungrounded in corpus.
page: AI506 Baseline Comparison (Page 8) or Threat Analysis
query: Anomalous quantum tachyon modulation detected across local Ethernet switch ports.
expected_behavior: Verification Specialist flags INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, triggers 1 feedback loop retry, and issues an explicit uncertainty qualification instead of hallucinating.
key_talking_point: Contrasts with Single-Agent RAG which hallucinates a fake quantum security vulnerability.
